name: Money+ Cute Expense Tracker
description:
【Inspiration & Ideas】
We believe that true tools are "simple and unpretentious," capable of solving problems effectively and reliably. They should not be limited by network or location, running stably even in signal-free deep mountains or ships sailing far at sea. In today's era of prevalent online applications, we insist on launching this offline accounting software to return tools to their essence, eliminate environmental dependencies, and provide only a pure, reliable accounting experience.

【Product Features】
Local Storage: Your data is in your hands, secure and worry-free (if you choose to create an iCloud backup, backup files will be uploaded to your iCloud space)
Lightning-Fast Accounting: Simplified operation process with built-in calculator input method, making every transaction record faster and more efficient.
Multi-dimensional Ledgers: Life, work, travel, childcare fund... Create independent ledgers for each specific scenario with clear records.
Flexible Accounts: Cash, credit cards, virtual accounts... Full support for detailed management of all your funds.
Personalized Members: Whether personal expenses or family member expenses (spouse, children, parents), everything can be clearly categorized.
Global Currencies: Support for major international currencies with convenient exchange rate management and conversion.
Budget Master: Flexible budget setting, real-time expense tracking to help you efficiently control finances and avoid overspending.
In-depth Income & Expense Analysis: Provides detailed income and expense reports for specified date ranges. Where every penny goes, what it's used for, and which account it comes from are all clearly presented.
Asset Trend Insights: Intuitive display of asset and net asset fluctuations and growth over specific time periods.
Inter-account Transfers: Simulates real money flow with thoughtful attention to detail.
Dream Savings: Set and track your savings goals to help you gradually achieve your life objectives.
Pure Experience: No ads to disturb, focus on accounting itself.

【Auto-Subscription Instructions】
1. Subscription Model: We offer monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription services. If you do not wish to continue your subscription, please ensure you manually turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle to avoid automatic renewal.
2. Subscription Fees: Monthly $1.49/month (USD), Annual $9.99/year (USD). Specific prices and promotional activities are subject to the display on the in-app subscription page. Price adjustments will take effect in your next subscription cycle.
3. Refund Policy: Current cycle fees for subscriptions usually cannot be refunded. If there is a free trial period, it will automatically convert to a paid subscription and charge after the trial ends. Please cancel the subscription before the trial period ends.
4. Cancel Subscription: If you do not intend to renew, you must manually turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current billing cycle ends. You can manage your subscriptions through iTunes/Apple ID settings or refer to relevant guidance within the app.
